preconditions.expression: all(c in '0123456789-' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The input string consists only of digits and hyphens.
The length of the input string is between 1 and 100,000 characters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == apocalypse_date and apocalypse_date is not None
postconditions.description: The output is the unique date in 'dd-mm-yyyy' format that appears strictly more times in the input than any other valid date.

postconditions.expression: apocalypse_date is not None and is_valid_date(apocalypse_date) and count_date_occurrences(stdin, apocalypse_date) > max(count_date_occurrences(stdin, date) for date in valid_dates if date != apocalypse_date)
postconditions.description: The output date is valid (2013 ≤ year ≤ 2015, 1 ≤ month ≤ 12, valid day for month/year) and its occurrence count exceeds all other valid dates' counts.

invariants.expression: is_valid_date(date) == (2013 <= int(date[6:10]) <= 2015 and 1 <= int(date[3:5]) <= 12 and is_valid_day(date))
invariants.description: A date is valid if its year is between 2013 and 2015, month is 1-12, and day is valid for that month/year (non-leap years).
A day is valid if it is between 1 and the number of days in its month/year (non-leap years).

invariants.expression: days_in_month(month, year) == (28 if month == 2 else 31 if month in [1, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10, 12] else 30)
invariants.description: Days in a month for non-leap years: 28 for February, 31 for Jan/Mar/May/Jul/Aug/Oct/Dec, 30 otherwise.
